hook: Surya Midha is a co-founder of Mercor, the AI training data marketplace that supplies expert contractors to AI labs, and has been reported as its chief operating officer. He co-founded the company with Brendan Foody and Adarsh Hiremath, school friends from Bellarmine College Preparatory, and is a Thiel Fellow.
